answer: Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the harbor of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the comet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
